newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC oil output down 320,000 bpd in May - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC oil output down 320,000 bpd in May - MEES.

text.p: OPEC oil output was down 320,000 barrels per day (bpd) in May to 26.7 million bpd led by lower flows from Iran and the United Arab Emirates, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.
Iranian output fell to 3.48 million bpd in May from 3.75 million bpd the previous month, reflected in exports dropping to 2.28 million bpd from 2.55 million bpd in April.

"Iranian production tends to fluctuate from month to month, but the average for the first five months of this year has been running at 3.618 million bpd, as compared with 3.667 million bpd for the year 1996 as a whole," MEES reported.

Output in the United Arab Emirates fell to 2.15 million bpd last month from 2.24 million bpd in April due to offshore maintenance. Flows from the Saudi-Kuwaiti Neutral Zone fell back 20,000 bpd in May to 510,000 bpd also because of maintenance.
Venezuela and Nigeria continued to lift production, increasing output by 20,000 bpd and 30,000 bpd to 3.22 million bpd and 2.18 million bpd respectively
The International Energy Agency (IEA) reported on Friday that OPEC had trimmed May output to 26.87 million bpd while a Reuters survey found the 11-member group pumped 26.95 million bpd.
